how: The Updates tab (public/js/v2/updates.js). Add a post at the TOP of posts: id (date plus a few words, never reused), date (YYYY-MM-DD), tag (new, fix, event or heads-up), title, body (plain words for players; a blank line starts a new paragraph). Optional pictures: image (the big one, {src, alt}) and gallery (up to 4 small ones, same shape); src is a file in public/updates/ (/updates/name.webp), alt says what the picture shows. The tab shows newest first by date. No money promises: say what changed, not what anyone can win.

posts.title: A Live wins row above the games
posts.body: On PC, recent wins now show above the games as a row of game cards, with each player's name under the card. The newest win slides in on the left.

posts.title: Pac-Man: everyone in classic yellow
posts.body:
Every Pac-Man in a match is now the classic yellow, so the maze is easier to read. Yours has a thin white outline, and everyone else has their name over them.

The Pac-Man on the Customize button chomps now too.

posts.title: Game screens match their cards
posts.body: Open any game and its screen now sits on its own card picture, zoomed in and softened, so every game looks like part of the same set.

image.alt: The Slither.io game screen on a soft, zoomed-in picture of its striped snake card

posts.title: New game cards
posts.body: Every game in the lobby has a new card, all painted in one bright style with the game's name on it. The player count now sits at the top of the card so it never covers the name.

image.alt: The lobby's row of new game cards: Pac-Man, Slither.io, Agar.io, Paper.io, Head Soccer, Swim, Knockout and Battleship

posts.title: Game cards react to your mouse
posts.body: Point at a game in the lobby and its card lifts, dims and shows a big play button, so you can see which one you are about to open.

image.alt: The lobby's row of game cards with the mouse over Slither.io, which is lifted and dimmed with a white play arrow in the middle

posts.title: A moving Head Soccer card
posts.body: The Head Soccer card in the lobby now plays a real header goal, under the lights.

posts.title: A new Paper.io card
posts.body: The Paper.io card in the lobby now plays a moment from a real game, on a black floor.

posts.title: A new Knockout card
posts.body: The Knockout card in the lobby now shows a real turn up close: four pieces, both players' arrows, and one knocked off the edge.

posts.title: A new Agar.io card
posts.body: The Agar.io card in the lobby now plays 30 seconds of a real game, on a black floor.

posts.title: Head Soccer: new look, 2-minute matches
posts.body:
Head Soccer has been redrawn from top to bottom: the stadium and its crowd, the goals and nets, the big scoreboard, and two new big-headed players.

Every match is now one 2-minute game, counting down from 2:00 on the board, with no half time.

Level at 0:00? One minute of sudden death: the next goal wins. If nobody scores in that minute, it ends in a draw.

image.alt: Head Soccer at kick-off: the packed stadium, the scoreboard reading 02:00, two big-headed players and the ball on the pitch

posts.title: A new Slither.io card
posts.body: The Slither.io card in the lobby now plays a moment from a real game, zoomed in on a black floor.

posts.title: Head Soccer has a new look
posts.body:
Head Soccer now plays in a sunny stadium packed with fans. The score sits at the bottom of the screen.

Every kick-off counts down 3, 2, 1 while the ball drops onto the centre spot. Run with the arrow keys, jump with Up (press it again in the air for a second jump) and kick with Space. On a phone the arrows are bottom left, Kick and Jump bottom right.

image.alt: Two big-headed players and the ball in the new Head Soccer stadium, with the clock on the big board and the score at the bottom

posts.title: Open lobbies now update live
posts.body: The Open lobbies list on the home page now changes the moment someone joins or leaves. A player waiting for a duel or sitting down at a paid table shows up within a second, no reload needed.

posts.title: The game cards move now
posts.body:
The game cards in the lobby are now short clips of each game being played: Slither.io, Paper.io, Agar.io, Pac-Man, Knockout, Battleship and Awesome Tanks.

They stop the moment you start a game, so they never slow it down.

image.alt: The lobby's row of game cards, each showing its game mid-play

posts.title: New game: Swim
posts.body:
Race one other player down an endless highway, both of you in the same traffic. Weave between the cars with W A S D or the arrow keys, or on a phone drag on the left to steer and hold Gas or Brake on the right.

Touch any car and you lose. Fall 200 m behind and you lose. The road gets faster and busier the longer you both last, so somebody always slips up.

If your connection drops mid-race, your car keeps driving straight for 5 seconds while you get back in.

image.alt: A gold car and a teal car racing down a desert highway at sunset, 148 km/h

posts.title: New game: Head Soccer
posts.body:
Head Soccer is here. Two big heads, one ball, a goal at each end and one minute on the clock. Most goals wins, and a tie at the end goes to sudden death: the next goal wins it.

Move with A and D or the arrow keys, jump with W, and kick with Space. On a phone, use the arrows on the left and Kick and Jump on the right.

It's a 1 on 1 duel. Find it in the lobby right after Pac-Man.

image.alt: Two big-headed players in a night stadium with a GOAL! banner over the pitch

posts.title: Pac-Man: your own power pellets
posts.body:
Chomp is now called Pac-Man. When you eat a power pellet, every ghost turns blue for you, and only for you. Other players still see normal ghosts unless they ate a pellet of their own. Eat a blue ghost and its eyes fly home, then it comes back out.

Fruit now gives you a short burst of speed for 3 seconds.

Customize works in Pac-Man too: pick a colour for your Pac-Man, or a Shop skin.

And pressing Play no longer flashes the old title screen first.

posts.title: Sign in and Add funds open in Privy
posts.body:
Sign in now opens Privy's own window, the wallet service that keeps your account safe. Pick Google, email, or Continue with a wallet for Phantom, Solflare or Backpack.

Add funds opens in Privy's window again too, with Pay with card and Receive funds.

image.alt: Privy's Log in or sign up window with the DuelSeries badge, email, Google and Continue with a wallet

posts.title: Join the clip team
posts.body:
Like making clips? The Join us tab now opens the DuelSeries clip team on Whop. It's free to join and has the clip rules.

Record your Free games, keep duelseries.com on screen, and share your best moments in #clips on our Discord.

image.alt: The DuelSeries clip team banner with Snake gameplay

posts.title: Top 10 right on the leaderboard
posts.body: The Leaderboards tab now shows the top 10 earners straight away, no extra tap to see the full list. Search for any player works the same as before.

posts.title: Battle royale: join or leave until the timer hits 0
posts.body:
When the 30 second call for the battle royale goes out, the doors stay open the whole time. You can jump in at the last second, and anyone already in can leave with Q (or CASH OUT on a phone) right up to the end of the countdown.

The moment the timer hits 0 the match starts with everyone inside, and from then on it is one life, last snake alive.

image.alt: The battle royale counting down, Starting in 21 and hold Q to leave at the top of the screen

posts.title: Add funds from Phantom
posts.body:
Signed in with Google or email and have Phantom, Solflare or Backpack? You can add funds straight from your wallet: pick an amount and approve once in your wallet.

Withdraw has a To Phantom button that fills in your wallet's address for you. You can unlink it any time on the Wallet tab.

posts.title: Play free without signing in, and bring a friend
posts.body:
Free games no longer need an account. Press Play and you are in as a guest. Sign in whenever you want your own name kept.

Every game screen has an Invite a friend button on Free. It copies a link that drops your friend straight into the same free game as you.

When a free game ends, press Share on the card for a picture of your score to post anywhere. A DuelSeries link pasted into Discord, iMessage or X now shows a real picture of the game. And our Discord is open: find it in Join us.

image.alt: The Share your score card over a Snake game, with Copy invite link and Save image

posts.title: A new loading screen
posts.body:
When DuelSeries opens, the crossed swords and the name now draw themselves in gold while the site loads, then fade into the lobby.

It only stays as long as loading takes. On a fast connection it is gone in a blink.

image.alt: The DuelSeries crossed swords emblem and name drawn in gold on a dark screen

posts.title: Chomp: one map that wraps around
posts.body:
The Chomp maze now wraps around like a globe. Run off any edge and you come back in on the other side, with no wall to stop you.

The camera stays on you from the moment you appear, and a pulse around your chomper shows you where you are while you are safe to get your bearings.

The maze also grows as more people join and shrinks again when it gets quiet, out of sight of everyone, so it always feels busy.

posts.title: Chomp is here
posts.body:
A new arena game in the lobby. Eat the dots, dodge the ghosts, and grab the gold coins anyone who gets caught drops on the maze. A power pellet turns nearby ghosts blue and lets you eat other players too.

Play a Free room or a paid one. Hold Q to cash out, and keep moving while the ring fills. On a phone, drag your thumb to steer and hold the Cash out button to leave.

image.alt: Chomp: a yellow chomper in a blue maze with ghosts, dots and the leaderboard

posts.title: Sign in with your own wallet
posts.body:
Sign in now has two choices: Continue with Google or email, the same as before, or Connect wallet.

Connect wallet works with Phantom, Solflare and Backpack. A wallet already installed in your browser shows as Detected. It becomes your DuelSeries wallet, and you approve each game in it.

On a phone, tap a wallet and DuelSeries opens inside that wallet's app.

image.alt: The Connect wallet sheet listing Phantom, Solflare and Backpack

gallery.alt: The Sign in sheet with Continue with Google or email and Connect wallet

posts.title: Paper.io arena grows with the crowd
posts.body:
The Paper.io arena now sizes itself to how many are playing, the same way slither.io does. When more join, the wall slowly moves out to make room. When players die or leave, it slowly closes back in.

A moving wall never kills you. It gently pushes you back inside and trims any land left past it.

posts.title: Battle royale every 6 hours
posts.body:
The battle royale now runs four times a day: 2 AM, 8 AM, 2 PM and 8 PM Eastern. The Events tab counts down to the next one.

When one is about to start you get 30 seconds to join. The Events tab glows and pulses, a card pops up that takes you straight there, and a sound plays so you don't miss it.

image.alt: The Events tab counting down the last seconds to join a battle royale

posts.title: New Graphics quality setting
posts.body:
Settings has a new Graphics choice. High is the look you know and stays the default.

Low turns off the food glow in slither, so the big fights where lots of snakes die at once stay smooth on slower computers. It is saved on this device and switches right away, even in the middle of a game.

posts.title: Knockout and Battleship find you a real player
posts.body:
When you press Play in Knockout or Battleship you now get a full minute to find another player, with a countdown on screen. If someone else queues in that minute, you two play each other. Two people queuing close together no longer end up in separate games.

Open lobbies now shows how many people are waiting for a duel, so you can jump in and play them.

posts.title: Money is in SOL now
posts.body:
Buy-ins, cash-outs, skins and prizes are now paid in SOL, straight from and to your wallet. Prices still show in US dollars, and each payment uses the live SOL price at that moment.

Add funds buys SOL, and it's ready to play right away, with no convert step. Keep a little SOL (about $0.15) in your wallet for network fees.

Still holding USDC from before? Open the Wallet tab: one tap converts it to SOL, or you can withdraw it as USDC.

posts.title: Paper.io moves up
posts.body: Paper.io now sits second, right after slither.io and before agar.io, everywhere the games are listed. It's been playing really well, so it's easier to find now.

posts.title: Signing up works first time
posts.body:
Some new players got stuck on "Creating your wallet" after signing in with Google, and Sign in stopped responding after that.

Your wallet is now set up for you right after you sign in, with a Try again button if your connection drops. If you got stuck before, just open the site again and it finishes on its own.

posts.title: Clips can record the whole screen
posts.body:
Turn on Settings > Clips > Record the whole screen and your clips show everything: the lobby, the end cards, the buttons you press and your mouse.

Your browser asks once per visit to share this tab. Say no and clips record just the game, like before. Press P any time to save the last 30 seconds.

image.alt: A frame from a whole-screen clip: the end card, the leaderboard and the mouse pointer

posts.title: Play again works every time
posts.body: Joining a cash room, or pressing Play again in one, sometimes timed out and did nothing. Entries now go through much more reliably, and if one ever does time out, the card tells you plainly and the next press works.

posts.title: New look for joining and error popups
posts.body:
The box you see while joining a cash room now matches the rest of the site, and it tells you each step in plain words. The loading ring now turns on every computer, including ones with animations turned off.

If an entry does not go through, the message now says what happened.

posts.title: Cash room leaderboards show dollars
posts.body:
In the $0.50 and $1 rooms of slither.io, agar.io and Paper.io, the leaderboard now ranks everyone by what they are holding, with the dollar amount next to each name. Spectating one of these rooms shows the same board.

Free rooms still rank by size.

posts.title: Every open lobby on one list
posts.body: Open lobbies on Home now shows every lobby at once, no scrolling inside the list. Paid lobbies with a game going sit at the top, the biggest buy-in first.

posts.title: See when a battle royale ends
posts.body:
While a battle royale is on, the Events tab now counts down to the moment the circle is fully closed.

If one snake is left sooner, the result shows straight away.

image.alt: The Events tab during a battle royale: Ends in, with minutes and seconds

posts.title: Knockout: see when they are ready
posts.body: In Knockout you now always see "They are ready" the moment your opponent locks in their shot, so you know when the round is about to play out.

posts.title: Sounds everywhere
posts.body:
Every button in the lobby now makes a short, soft sound the moment you press it. The important ones, like adding funds, withdrawing and unlocking a skin, have their own.

Every game has new sounds too: eating, boosting, kills, the cash-out ring and a proper fanfare when you cash out. Knockout, Paper.io and Bowmasters were silent before, now they are not.

Turn them down or off in Settings, under Sound. The soft tick when your mouse moves onto a button has its own switch.

image.alt: The new Sound group in Settings: Lobby sounds, Volume and Hover sounds

posts.title: Updates now come with pictures
posts.body: Every post here shows what changed. Click a picture to see it large.

image.alt: The Updates tab with a picture on each post

posts.title: A new end card, and a gold cash-out ring
posts.body:
Cash out and a gold coin lands on your card with what you won, your time, rank and kills. Lobby, Spectate and Play again sit in one row.

Holding to cash out now draws a gold ring that counts three seconds, the same in every game.

image.alt: The end card with a gold coin after a cash-out

gallery.alt: The gold cash-out ring filling up

posts.title: Share your clips straight to DuelSeries
posts.body:
After you save a clip with P, one tap shares it to DuelSeries. You can also upload a saved clip in the Clips tab, and delete your own clips any time.

Every clip is checked before anyone else can see it.

image.alt: The Clips tab with Upload a clip and Send a link

posts.title: New Join us tab
posts.body: Find the Discord, the clip team and our socials in one place, invite a friend, or send us a bug or an idea.

image.alt: The Join us tab

posts.title: Lobby sounds
posts.body: Buttons in the lobby now make a short, soft sound when you tap them. Turn them down or off in Settings under Sound.

posts.title: Battle royale fits your phone
posts.body: Join now sits on the left with Spectate beside it, and the battle royale screen fits a phone without cutting anything off.

image.alt: The battle royale card on a phone with Join and Spectate

posts.title: Slither.io turns smoother and lags less
posts.body: Your snake turns more smoothly, the game no longer stutters when the lobby is open behind it, and on phones it is drawn at the size slither.io players know.

posts.title: Agar.io: safer starts and better phone control
posts.body: In free rooms you now start away from cells that could eat you, cells no longer pop in at the edge of your screen, and on a phone how far your thumb moves sets your speed. The leaderboard now shows each player's score.

posts.title: Battle royale: one life per match
posts.body:
Each battle royale is now one life. Get knocked out and you are out until the next match, so spectate to the end and see who takes it.

The circle keeps closing until a single snake is left. When it is over the result stays on your screen, and Join next puts you in for the following match.

The nightly match still starts at 8:05 PM Eastern.

posts.title: Press P to save a clip
posts.body:
On a PC, every game keeps the last 30 seconds. Press P and they save as a video in your Downloads, with the game sound, ready to post. After a cash-out or a battle royale win the game offers to save one for you.

Post it on X, YouTube or TikTok and send the link in the Clips tab to get it on the wall.

image.alt: The Clips tab: player clips on the wall and the top clippers beside them

posts.title: Social is now Leaderboards
posts.body: The top 3 live, the full top 10, and a search box for any player to see their games and win rate.

image.alt: The Leaderboards tab with the live top 3 and player search

posts.title: Skins you can unlock
posts.body: Open Customize under Play and unlock a skin. You wear it in every game straight away.

image.alt: The Candy Cane skin in Customize

posts.title: Figures that count up
posts.body: Your wallet balance, the leaderboards and the battle royale podium count up when you open them.

image.alt: Leaderboard figures counting up as the tab opens

posts.title: One end screen for every game
posts.body: Cash out, get knocked out or finish a match and every game now shows the same clear card and leaderboard.

image.alt: The new cash-out card

posts.title: Smoother swipes on phones
posts.body: Swiping between tabs and between games is smoother, even on slower phones.

image.alt: Home, a game and Leaderboards on a phone

gallery.alt: A game screen on a phone
